subject: mathematics
concept: Comparing length directly (longer, shorter, same length)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student lines up two virtual objects at a shared starting edge to compare length
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the longer or shorter object in a pictured pair
exercise.abstract: Student orders a small set of objects by length from shortest to longest

misconception_flags: compares objects without aligning their starting edges

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
